            Question: Based on the following problem description and data, formulate a complete mathematical model. In the construction sector, there is a group of managers and a set of construction projects. The cost for a manager to oversee a specific project varies depending on their expertise and experience. This cost data is stored in a CSV file named 'manager_project_cost.csv', where each row corresponds to a manager and each column indicates the cost for that manager to handle a particular project. The aim is to determine the optimal assignment strategy that minimizes the overall cost of completing all projects. Every project must be managed by exactly one manager, and each manager must be responsible for exactly one project. Assignments are chosen jointly to minimize total cost; an individual manager need not receive their cheapest project. The goal is to minimize the total cost while adhering to the constraints that each project is assigned to one manager and each manager is assigned to one project

            User Description: There are 15 candidate plants F1–F15. Each plant can either be built (opened) or not. Building a plant incurs a fixed opening cost, and this cost is charged only once per plant, independent of how many customers the plant eventually serves. Once a plant is opened, it may supply products to any customers, subject to its own capacity.

    There are 15 customers C1–C15 with fixed demands. If a plant is built, it incurs the fixed cost and can distribute to any number of customers. Shipping from plant i to customer j incurs a per-unit transport cost. The objective is to determine which plants should be built and how much to ship from each built plant to each customer in order to minimize the total cost, consisting of both fixed opening costs and variable transportation costs, while satisfying all customer demands and not exceeding the capacities of the opened plants.

    The input data are given in two CSV files. cost.csv includes fixed_cost: opening cost of the plant (currency units; paid once if the plant is opened, regardless of the number of customers served). And capacity: plant capacity (maximum units the plant can supply). And also C1 … C15: per-unit transport cost from this plant to each customer. demand.csv includes demand of the customer (units) (C1-C15)
